notes.title: Game Update v1.7.13
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005158/446a7aaa5e9c7aefb55dc91c1fb1682d8e5e0927.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[h3][b]Custom Model Integration[/b][/h3] You can now import custom 3D files in FBX format, giving you the flexibility to design maps in your favourite 3D modelling software. Whether you're creating fully custom maps, enhancing them with imported models, or using in-game assets to build your designs, everything can be seamlessly integrated into the MapMaker level. Once complete, you can share your fully crafted maps with the community via the Steam Workshop.

[h3][b]Bouncy Objects[/b][/h3] The MapMaker level now includes the ability to designate objects as "bouncy." These objects provide an extra rebound effect, adding dynamic interactions when your ball makes contact.


I’ve uploaded a map called "Water Park 1" to the Steam Workshop, showcasing these new features.



[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
Numerous improvements and fixes primarily focused on enhancing the functionality of the MapMaker.


[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
The map-maker HUD has been improved.

notes.title: Game Update v1.6.12
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005158/446a7aaa5e9c7aefb55dc91c1fb1682d8e5e0927.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[h3][b]CSG Mesh[/b][/h3] You can now use cubes, spheres and cylinders to make holes in mesh in the map maker! I've uploaded a map that demonstrates this to the workshop.

[h3][b]Arenas for the map maker[/b][/h3] I've added two 'arenas' to the map maker (more will be added), these provide an area to make maps in instead of needing to create them. 

[h3][b]Landscapes[/b][/h3] You can now place landscapes in the map maker. These allow you to paint landscape heights and paint in holes with round and square brushes. 

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
Some buttons were hard to click, this has been resolved.
Map maker rotation discrepancies have been resolved.
Atmosphere intensity updates when light intensity changes.
Resolved an issue that prevented the player board from opening when testing custom-made maps in the map maker.
Bunting can now be selected in the map maker.
Bunting is now created properly.

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
Spectator pawn movement speed has been increased.
map maker has customisable movement speed.

notes.title: Game Update v1.4.8
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005158/fd82c572aff6b3f663f06682e180ff438fc38975.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[h3]Improved Visuals[/h3] Lumen from UnrealEngine. You can turn this on in the settings HUD. (Experimental)

[h3]3 Collision Modes[/h3] [b]No collisions[/b] between players, [b]hard collisions[/b] (other players' balls won't move if you hit them) and [b]soft collisions[/b] (other players' balls will move if you hit them).

[h3]RGB Balls[/h3] The hue of your ball can shift through the colour spectrum.


[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
Other players can now hear your ball hits and the rolling sounds.
Player profile HUD has been updated.


[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
Many fixes.

notes.title: Game Update v1.2.6 - New Map
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005158/39389afaf9ba6927b24663ccf726e27059e7530c.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[h3][b]Skills Map[/b][/h3] Designed to push your skills to the limit! This update introduces target-like platforms for holes, where scoring zones are strategically placed to reward precision. Here’s what to expect:

[b]Dynamic Scoring[/b]: Holes feature target-like platforms with point zones. The closer you get to the centre of the target, the higher the points you earn. Additionally, longer putts will earn you extra points, making distance and accuracy key to high scores.

[b]Varied Challenges[/b]: Some holes include wind effects and moving holes to test your skill further.

Get ready to refine your technique and achieve the highest scores in this exciting new map!



[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

The lighting has been improved.

Curved ramps have been changed to non-curved ramps to prevent the ball bouncing in unexpected ways.

notes.notes:

Sorry if it caused any frustration!

notes.title: Game Update v1.1.4
notes.notes:

Fixed a water trap in the lobby with a solid collision preventing the ball from passing through it.


[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

Stabilized ball collisions when balls are stationary, resolving issues with repeating ball hit sounds and jittery ball movements in multiplayer.

notes.title: Game Update v1.1.1 - BallTextures
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45005158/4fa506c2c971e73bd35c4bd94db443d51f1f0dad_400x225.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]

[h3][b]Player Ball Textures[/b][/h3] Enhanced visual appeal with 22 newly added textures for player balls, each with an inverted option, totalling 44 variations. These textures can also change colour depending on the player's ball colour setting, allowing for further personalization and making your ball stand out.

[h3]Mouse and Controller Sensitivity Options[/h3] Added new settings that allow you to customize the sensitivity for both mouse and controller inputs.


[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

Some achievements are now harder to achieve.

notes.title: Hybrid Mini Golf Released!
notes.notes:
[h1]🎉 Exciting News! The Hybrid Mini Golf Release is Here![/h1]
Hey everyone,

I'm thrilled to announce that Hybrid Mini Golf is finally live on Steam! I hope you have an absolute blast playing it. Your feedback means the world to me, so please drop by the discussion section with any thoughts, suggestions, or bugs you encounter.

[b]This project is a labor of love from a one-man team, and your support and patience are immensely appreciated. Let's make this game the best it can be together![/b]

Happy golfing! ⛳
